sources.observation: Live Russian retail banking homepage offers accounts/cards and application; footer identifies АО «Райффайзенбанк», copyright 2003–2026, Bank of Russia general license 3292 dated 17.02.2015 and Moscow address. Head links fav/icon.svg and JSON-LD explicitly names that URL as bank logo. This establishes operating Russian bank brand, not automatic substitution with international parent. Downloaded original vector contains standalone crossed horse-head/gable mark in #2B2D33 on #FEE600 rounded plain field; inspected source reference shows no wordmark or frame.
